label: Bible Study
prompt: The wicked flee when no man pursueth: but the righteous are bold as a _____.
verse: The wicked flee when no man pursueth: but the righteous are bold as a lion.
note: The guilty jump at shadows; the righteous stand their ground like a lion.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Fight the good fight of _____, lay hold on eternal life, whereunto thou art also called, and hast professed a good profession before many witnesses.
verse: Fight the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life, whereunto thou art also called, and hast professed a good profession before many witnesses.
note: Paul coaches young Timothy: fight the good fight of faith and lay hold on eternal life.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he looked up, and said, I see men as _____, walking.
verse: And he looked up, and said, I see men as trees, walking.
note: A healing in two stages: after the first touch, the blind man of Bethsaida saw men like walking trees.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Turn thou us unto thee, O LORD, and we shall be turned; _____ our days as of old.
verse: Turn thou us unto thee, O LORD, and we shall be turned; renew our days as of old.
note: Lamentations' closing prayer: turn us back to you, and make our days new as of old.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: For he is our peace, who hath made both one, and hath broken down the middle wall of _____ between us;
verse: For he is our peace, who hath made both one, and hath broken down the middle wall of partition between us;
note: 'The middle wall of partition' between Jew and Gentile — broken down by Christ, who 'is our peace.'
